acceptanceCriteria: Open-file count is measured at 100k synthetic receipts on the complete route and on the fallback route (median of 5, load band recorded).
Descriptor use is bounded by a constant (or a documented small bound) independent of receipt count, with a test at two store sizes.
body:
Location: Tasks WatchChanges change guard and the complete audit route (internal/tasks/store, internal/tasks/journal). Related, completed: V1-0841 (5000-receipt descriptor exhaustion); umbrella V1-0893. Observed: the complete route and its fallback open files proportional to receipt count; at 100k receipts the process-wide descriptor limit is at risk (ENFILE/EMFILE). Expected: open descriptors bounded independent of history length.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: CAL-V0-219..221 journal/store descriptor-bound tests (-race). Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: corvint-tasks WatchChanges and the complete-route audit open O(receipts) files; ENFILE risk at 100k receipts
